newsitem.title: USA: Capital One to buy JCPenney unit deposit franchise.
newsitem.headline: Capital One to buy JCPenney unit deposit franchise.

text.p: Capital One FSB said Tuesday it has reached an agreement to buy the national retail deposit franchise of JCPenney National Bank, a unit of retailer J.C. Penney Co Inc.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
Capital One said the JCPenney bank's deposit balances are approximately $425 million and the acquisition is expected to close in early October, subject to regulatory approval/
Capital One operates subsidiaries that are among the largest providers of MasterCard and Visa credit cards in the U.S.
Dave Willey, senior vice preisdent of Captial One, said the acquisition will diversify Capital One's retail funding business.
Earlier this year, JCPenney National Bank sold its bank credit card portfolio of about $740 million to Associates First Capital Corp of Dallas.
In May the bank agreed to sell its branch network and realated assets for undisclosed terms to the First National Bank of Wyoming.
